nom: Paula's Choice Resist Barrier Repair Advanced Moisturiser With Ceramides

avis.titre: My Go - to for Sensitive / damaged skin
avis.texte: My Go-To for Sensitive Skin I’ve searched extensively for a reliable, everyday moisturizer suitable for very sensitive skin, and this is it. I have a rare autoimmune condition called dermatomyositis, which affects my skin and muscles, so keeping my skin comfortable and glowing is a full-time effort. In addition to my morning routine, I need a moisturizer that works well under SPF—and this one delivers perfectly. Hands down, it feels like it was made for people with sensitive skin like mine. Pros: • Smooth and easy to apply • Very moisturizing, even on dry, scaly areas • Non-shiny finish makes it a great primer • Works beautifully with Paula’s Choice lightly tinted SPF • Gentle on eyes; does not cause tearing • Fragrance-free and allergy-friendly • Elegant, convenient packaging • noticeable difference in my skin after weeks of use. Cons: • The bottle is deceiving ; I go through it quickly Disclosure: I purchased this product myself and am sharing my personal experience.

avis.titre: Not for me…. But still nice
avis.texte: I’m kind of sad this product didn’t work for me, but my skin is super sensitive and doesn’t like change very much. It does have a nice, thick texture, and it’s not scented which is always good. I do have acne prone skin with eczema around my chin area. This is honestly the hardest part to not be so dry. Thought I’d give this product a try and well, it just didn’t work for me. I do like Paula’s Choice though, and think this would still be a great option for people who may not have super dry, sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Great lightweight moisturizer for humid climates and sensitive skin
avis.texte: This has been a great moisturizer for my sensitive skin, especially in humid weather. After dealing with a significant scar and scar-removal treatment, my skin became much more reactive and prone to inflammation. This formula helps support my skin barrier thanks to ingredients like ceramide EOP, which I’ve found really helpful for restoring the lipid layer. What I especially like is that it’s lightweight and not occlusive. I live in Atlanta where humidity is often above 70%, and heavy moisturizers or products with a lot of dimethicone tend to trap heat and make my skin red and irritated. This one hydrates without that sealed-in feeling. When humidity drops below about 40% I’ll sometimes switch to CeraVe PM, but most of the year this is the moisturizer I reach for. I apply it right after a shower or after misting my face with mineral water and spread a very thin layer, which works perfectly for me
A thick cream. Love that it’s fragrance free. Feels moisturizing, however might be better for winter time since it is thicker. I’ll definitely use the entire bottle, but might not purchase it again

avis.titre: Great moisturizer for AM and PM.
avis.texte: Purchased this in hopes to replace a very expensive high end moisturizer that I loved but couldn’t afford anymore. Almost through my first bottle and I love it! I only use it in the AM typically. Very lightweight, doesn’t have a strong smell, and didn’t break me out.

nicely packaged with the paulas choice seal in tact so it was completely sealed. Full bottle. No problems with getting my paulas choice from amazon. I use retinoids and this has been the best moisturizer to pair with that and other actives.
I've used for at least 10 hrs. It is my absolute favorite skin product.

avis.titre: Better then I thought it would be
avis.texte: At first one I use this it felt a little lightweight and I didn’t think that it would be a barrier moisturizer. Man was I wrong! It is the perfect amount of moisturizing without creating excess oil I really like the way it feels and it doesn’t smell.

I ordered this for my (almost) 40 year old skin. I have a hard time with heavy moisturizers, so i was looking for something light and I liked this PM moisturizer because it doesn't have SPF in it - something that I don't need or what in a moisturizer in the evening. I felt like one pump of this was enough to cover my face and neck and it felt light going on, and then weightless on my skin afterward. This is going to last quite a while given that one pump is all I need, so I can't even contemplate buying more right now. Hydration: I would say it's pretty hydrating for my skin, which is pretty normal with oil production. I felt like the moisturization feeling lasted, but wasn't greasy, and that's exactly what I want out of a moisturizer. The only think I don't like about it is the "unscented" scent. It smells like. . .lotion. It fades once it's on your skin but I'd honestly prefer a little scent to block out the unscented lotion chemical smell. That's likely a me thing.

avis.titre: Great moisturizer choice for this grandma's skin
avis.texte: Skincare for seniors is so confusing everyone shouts use me, use me so it's hard for me to know what to use, but when I saw this moisturizer I was impressed by the ingredients and the fact that its cruelty free and USA made so I tried it. I LOVE it, it moisturizes without leaving my skin feeling oily, it penetrates quickly and I love that its unscented. I just wish it had its own SPF included. I'm really liking it so far, I've been using it for several weeks and I would definitely recommend this product.

I have never tried a Paula’s Choice product I didn’t like! This one is so hydrating and thick! I have really dry skin and use the Paula’s Choice RESIST Triple Active Total Repair Serum at night and now this after. Amazing combination! Works so much better than the other moisturizers I’ve used. I do wish the price point was more affordable, especially since this is a smaller amount of product. A little does go a long way though. My skin really loves this!
Excellent quality brand !! This skin barrier cream Is great for my sensitive dry skin . Fast absorbing and not stick . Leaves my face hydrated and nourished.

They say this could be worn during the day or not so I would apply this during my night skincare routine AND morning. HUGE mistake. My skin barrier is soooooo compromised!!! My skin is tight, dry, flakey and inflamed. It’s red and my eyes are puffy and swollen. I only used this product for a week and that’s all it took to destroy my skin. I’m not having to reverse the damage and it’s a slow process. Would not recommend if you have sensitive skin. I stopped using this product 2 nights ago, and my skin is still very tight, flakey and inflamed.
